h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment List: 15 Machines and What They Do

props.title: Outdoor Gym Equipment List: 15 Machines and What They Do
props.summaryText: The outdoor gym machines you will find in Indian parks and societies, what each one works, who it suits, and how to combine them into a useful set.
props.author: karan-desai
props.imageAlt: Man exercising on a pull-up bar at an outdoor gym

takeaways.text: Outdoor gym machines use body weight for resistance, so they suit a wide range of fitness levels.
Walkers and cross trainers are the most used machines in almost every open gym.
Twisters, tai chi wheels and shoulder twirls are gentle and popular with older users.
Combination machines (two or three exercises on one post) save space and budget.

faq.q: What equipment is in an outdoor gym?
faq.a: Common outdoor gym equipment includes air walkers, cross trainers, cycles, rowers and step trainers for cardio; leg press, leg extension, chest press and shoulder press for strength; pull-up and parallel bars for upper body; and twisters, tai chi wheels and shoulder twirls for flexibility.

faq.q: Which outdoor gym equipment is best for beginners?
faq.a: Walkers, cycles, twisters and tai chi wheels are easy to use and low impact. Leg press and chest press machines use body weight, so beginners can control the effort.

faq.q: What is a multi gym in an outdoor gym?
faq.a: A multi gym combines several exercise stations on one frame, such as pull-up bars, parallel bars and sit-up benches, so several people can exercise in a compact footprint.
